title: DOW-UAP-D079, Narrative Statement 1, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a memorandum for record from the Department of War containing a first-hand narrative of UAP sightings reported to AARO by a federal law enforcement agent.

incidents.summary: Witness 1 and team member observed a large glowing ball with a swirly lava-like pattern near a hillside.
incidents.quote: It was just a circle of light that looked like a swirly pattern of bright lava.

incidents.summary: Witness 1 observed an orange light in the sky that released three red lights, accompanied by a flash on the horizon.
incidents.quote: While it was lit, it appeared three red lights flew out of and away from it.

incidents.summary: Witness 1 observed a second orange light event with red lights departing in a vertical alignment, accompanied by a flash.
incidents.quote: This time however, the red lights appeared to leave in a different pattern

incidents.summary: Witness 1 observed a vehicle-like object that hovered, moved off-road without kicking up dust, and then flew away as a dark object.
incidents.quote: It did not bounce or move with the terrain, but seemed to hover.

incidents.summary: Witness 1 observed a translucent, floating object with one round and one square light spot, appearing to have a vertical orientation.
incidents.quote: It was almost like looking at something through water where it was not completely clear.
